title: Beyond Static Priors: Dynamic Neural Guidance for Large-Scale Ant Colony Optimization

problem.claim: Neural-guided ACO faces training-inference misalignment because policies are trained to generate static priors but deployed to guide iterative, long-horizon search.

gap.claim: Static-prior guidance does not align neural training with the dynamics of iterative search.

contributions.claim: DyNACO provides dynamic neural guidance by periodically observing pheromone distribution and the incumbent solution.
DyNACO combines a perturbation-based ACO backend with scope-restricted refinement to support scale, efficacy, and stable credit assignment.
The framework is extended from TSP to CVRP using a capacity-aware backend.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe DyNACO as a novel framework for dynamic neural guidance.

author_reported_evidence.claim: On TSP, DyNACO scales to 100,000-node instances and outperforms neural baselines while often reducing total runtime relative to the unguided solver.
On CVRP, DyNACO consistently improves the unguided baseline with less than 1% neural overhead.
The authors report in-depth analysis of generalization and of why dynamic guidance outperforms static priors.

narrative_sequence.summary: Neural-guided ACO has a training-inference misalignment between static priors and iterative search.
DyNACO introduces periodic observation of pheromone distribution and the incumbent solution for dynamic guidance.
A perturbation-based backend and scope-restricted refinement make the approach tractable and support stable credit assignment.
The approach is reported to scale on TSP, improve neural and unguided baselines, and extend to CVRP with low neural overhead.
The work argues that neural training should align with iterative search dynamics.

source_observation.claim: Dynamic guidance uses observations of the evolving pheromone distribution and incumbent solution during search.

interpretation.claim: Learning-guided optimization may benefit when model inputs and training objectives reflect the search state over time rather than a fixed prior.

application.claim: For iterative optimization systems, consider periodically updating neural guidance from solver-state signals.

exception.claim: The abstract does not specify which problem classes, solver configurations, or state signals beyond the reported settings are required for this approach to work.

unknowns: Training procedure, model architecture, and guidance update frequency are unspecified.
Benchmark coverage, comparison details, and statistical results are unspecified.
The reported generalization analysis and explanation of dynamic guidance are not detailed.
